settings.eyebrow: An Open Court Event · Prythian Awaits
settings.heading: A NIGHT BETWEEN STARS AND SHADOWS
settings.intro: Something magical is coming. The countdown to our biggest event of the year has begun, a night of wonder, ceremony and celebration worthy of Prythian.
settings.invite_headline: Doors to the invitations open Friday at 14:00
settings.invite_subtext: A limited number of invitations will be released. When the doors open, the Court will be watching: be ready!
settings.body:
Join us for a midnight party in honour of the world we love. Expect crafts, games, and a gathering of the Court beneath the stars.

Guests will receive exclusive preorder gifts, and the evening will be a celebration worthy of Prythian — from the first candle to the final dance.

Full details, dress code and the guest list will be revealed once invitations open.
